rv.q: Ambitious examination of grief from Mohamed-Zain Dada

Grief is a difficult subject to broach for any age group, but Dizzy by Mohamed-Zain Dada ( Zain ) at the Half Moon Theatre is an intelligent, moving and at times humorous example of writing about it for teenagers. Qamar's ( Sera Mustafa ) brother Yaseen has died and she's struggling to make sense of it.
